'''Vo'karr Er To''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]. He was a dangerous criminal and, when he escaped from a maximum security [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] top ten most wanted fugitives. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked him down and killed him.
